cohort: 4,898,441 women in the United States between 2012 and 2020
finding: Women with TOLAC utilization were associated with significantly lower risks of maternal unplanned hysterectomy, admission to intensive care, and neonatal seizures, but advanced maternal age, higher maternal body mass index, more than 2 previous caesarean deliveries, having maternal co-morbidities and fetal malpresentation increased the likelihood of maternal and neonatal morbidities in women who attempted TOLAC.
